title: MigrationLogEntry
description: The payload shape both UNIT-CMS-0011's own migration writes and UNIT-CMS-0012's logging call (ADR-0001) supply to record one migration outcome. Mirrors the migration_log table (interfaces/0002_migration_log.sql). Satisfies R9, R10.

sourceTable.description: The legacy source table/entity type this outcome is about, e.g. 'pp_brokerage', 'pp_agency_cga', 'pp_agent' (UNIT-CMS-0012's CGA-reconciliation source).

sourceId.description: The legacy record's identifying key, as a string regardless of its native legacy type (int or nvarchar) — required so DR-6's Agency_ID type mismatch never has to be reconciled in this contract.

outcome.description: The terminal state this source record reached. Closed set — matches migration_log_outcome.

reason.description: Required (non-null) when outcome is 'skipped' or 'failed'; must be null when outcome is 'migrated'. A closed set of reason codes is expected (design.md § Cross-cutting, error model): unmapped_lookup_value, unrecognized_history_value, parent_not_migrated, agency_id_unresolvable, phone_unparseable, missing_required_date, target_write_rejected. Never free text and never a personal-data field (R22).

targetId.description: Required (non-null) when outcome is 'migrated' — the newly-created target-schema record's id (UNIT-CMS-0005's schema). Must be null for 'skipped'/'failed'. Additive field beyond CAP-CMS-0006's capability-design MigrationLog shape; see design.md Data model.

processedBy.description: Which unit's logging call produced this row — a provenance tag, not a second writer of the underlying table (XD-0002, ADR-0001).

processedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of when this outcome was recorded.
